mapper.select: SELECT name, url, api_key, model, weight, enabled, vision_enabled FROM ai_provider ORDER BY name
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_provider(name, url, api_key, model, weight, enabled, vision_enabled, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{name}, #{url}, #{apiKey}, #{model}, #{weight}, #{enabled}, #{visionEnabled}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_provider SET url = #{url}, api_key = #{apiKey}, model = #{model}, weight = #{weight}, enabled = #{enabled}, vision_enabled = #{visionEnabled}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE name = #{name}
UPDATE ai_provider SET vision_enabled = 0, updated_at = NOW() WHERE vision_enabled = 1 AND name != #{name}
